decisions.reason: The inertial measurement module draws on the firm's existing sensor and electronics knowledge, so it can interpret early market feedback and refine the product, although its limited website presence points to uncertain traction.
The AC voltage input module sits squarely within the firm's core industrial I/O competence and has a dedicated page, which suggests strong related knowledge and commercial commitment.
The solid state relay module closely complements the firm's industrial I/O portfolio, so the firm can readily absorb customer feedback and improve it at low incremental cost.

The server room monitoring kit reuses the firm's sensor know-how but targets an IT facility market where it has less related knowledge, which raises the risk of dropping it, though one year is too early to learn whether it works.
